title: Scrolling Tab Strip
description: More tabs than the width can show, with a separator pipe before each Tab after the first: TabList scrolls its strip sideways and fades the tabs at each end while more tabs lie that way. With a fine pointer, Previous tabs and Next tabs buttons show beside the strip, outside the tab list, and a press keeps focus on the selected tab. Keyboard focus and selection scroll the tab into view, clear of the fades and buttons. Use it for a long or dynamic list of tabs that must stay on one line.
